title: DECISION: Double-gate in wolfssl_ec_key helpers is intentional defense-in-depth
description: wolfssl_ec_key_export_public() and wolfssl_ec_key_export_private() (wolfssl_ec_key.c) each call wolfssl_fips_gate() directly, even though the per-algo wrappers in ecdh.c and ecdsa.c that call them also gate. The double-gate is safe (fips_gate has no side effects) and provides defense-in-depth: if a future caller is written that calls these helpers without a wrapper gate, the helpers still enforce the gate. A reviewer who says 'remove the redundant gate' is removing defense-in-depth from a FIPS boundary. Confirmed correct in pass2 audit (WOLFKM-7sx).
close_reason: Design decision recorded; no code change needed.
